securityResearch.severityPolicy: No speculative severity was assigned; Todo 3 implemented and tested the concrete attack paths in THREAT_MODEL.md.

sourceEvidence.observed: OpenCode is unsandboxed; server mode needs an explicitly configured Basic Auth password.
Serve strips spoofed incoming identity/capability headers, injects authenticated values, and recommends a loopback backend.
A tailnet with no policy section uses a default allow-all policy.
WireGuard protects the data plane and DERP relays encrypted packets; encryption does not replace application authorization.
